project_type: SvelteKit 3.1 (Svelte 5.57 runes) app with adapter-node; server-side services over Drizzle/Postgres; pure bracket engine in src/lib/brackets
build_system: pnpm 10.28 via corepack (`corepack pnpm <cmd>`; pnpm is not on PATH). Vite 8 + @sveltejs/kit 3.1.1. Paraglide compiles messages/en.json into src/lib/paraglide (gitignored) during `check`/build. `#lib/...` subpath imports MUST include the file extension (e.g. `#lib/server/db/index.ts`, `#lib/paraglide/messages.js`); relative imports inside services omit it (`./errors`). Env vars are declared in src/env.ts and read from `$app/env/private`.
test_framework: Vitest 4 with two projects in vite.config.ts: `server` (src/**/*.spec.ts, pure) and `db` (src/**/*.db.spec.ts against TEST_DATABASE_URL, default postgres://root:mysecretpassword@localhost:5432/tournament_test, schema dropped and re-migrated by src/lib/server/testing/db-setup.ts, files run serially). `expect.requireAssertions: true` — every test must assert. Playwright 1.64 e2e in e2e/*.e2e.ts; webServer runs `node scripts/migrate.js && pnpm build && node build` on port 4173 against E2E_DATABASE_URL (tournament_e2e) with AUTH_MODULES=dev, TRUSTED_AUTH_MODULES=dev, ALLOW_DEV_AUTH=true.
test_command: corepack pnpm test:unit --run   (then e2e: $env:PATH = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\corepack-shims;$env:PATH"; corepack pnpm test:e2e)
verification_instructions: 1) corepack pnpm format (normalizes CRLF->LF and formats new files; also touches .agents/** which is fine). 2) corepack pnpm check -> 0 errors, 0 warnings. 3) corepack pnpm lint -> prettier --check . && eslint . pass. 4) corepack pnpm test:unit --run -> all server + db tests pass (baseline: 21 files / 252 tests). 5) For e2e, in the SAME shell call: $env:PATH = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\corepack-shims;$env:PATH"; corepack pnpm test:e2e (allow ~15 min timeout; target one file with `corepack pnpm test:e2e e2e/matches.e2e.ts`). Schema change: corepack pnpm db:generate --name match_room (if drizzle-kit reports DATABASE_URL missing, first $env:DATABASE_URL='postgres://root:mysecretpassword@localhost:5432/local'), then corepack pnpm db:migrate.
snapshot_or_generated_files: drizzle/0003_match_room.sql, drizzle/meta/0003_snapshot.json and drizzle/meta/_journal.json are generated by `corepack pnpm db:generate --name match_room` and are committed with the schema change. Never hand-edit them. src/lib/paraglide is generated and gitignored.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell; each shell call is a fresh session, so env changes (PATH, DATABASE_URL) must be set in the same command. Postgres runs in Docker container tournament-db-1 (healthy); databases local, tournament_test, tournament_e2e exist. pnpm shims for Playwright's webServer were created at %LOCALAPPDATA%\corepack-shims — prefix e2e runs with $env:PATH = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\corepack-shims;$env:PATH". Playwright Chromium is installed. scripts/migrate.js fails on Windows until FEAT-001 step 1 fixes it (fileURLToPath). git core.autocrlf=true: after `pnpm format` git status lists ~166 files as ' M' with NO content diff (`git diff --numstat` is empty for them) — never stage those; only stage the files listed in plan.md's Digest. .env exists (copied from .env.example) and must never be committed. .agents/ is untracked and must never be staged. Do NOT commit in FEAT steps; the single M6 commit happens in the final step. Never push. No new dependencies.
contribution_requirements: Match existing style exactly: tabs, single quotes, no trailing commas, printWidth 100 (prettier.config.js), terse doc comments in the existing tone. Every new UI string goes in messages/en.json (Paraglide, used as m.key()). Form actions validate with Zod schemas exported from services (pattern: apiKeyNameSchema / tournamentSchema) and call services/* functions (M7 REST will reuse them). Authorization at the edge with guards (requireUser, requireTournamentAdmin, loadTournament); tournament phase/permission rules inside services throwing ServiceError (English messages shown to the user). Migrations generated with drizzle-kit and committed with the schema. Single commit message style: 'Add the match room with chat, reporting and disputes (M6)' + short bullet body like the M4 commit. docs/PLAN.md: M6 ✅ in the milestones table + '## Implementation notes (M6)' after the M5 notes.
key_patterns: Services: `db.transaction(async (tx) => …)`, stage row locked with lockStage (SELECT … FOR UPDATE) before result changes; refreshStage(tx, stageId) is the only place that turns templates+results into stored match state. Route actions: `const { tournament } = await requireTournamentAdmin(event)` / `loadTournament(event)`; `try { await service() } catch (e) { if (e instanceof ServiceError) return fail(400, { error: e.message }); throw e; }`; success returns `{ message: m.x() }`; small local helpers like `change()`/`act()` (admin/participants/+page.server.ts, t/[org]/[tournament]/+page.server.ts). Svelte: `let { data, form }: PageProps = $props()`, `$derived`, writable `$derived` (admin/theme/+page.svelte), `use:enhance`, `resolve('/route/[param]', params)` from $app/paths for every href (eslint svelte/no-navigation-without-resolve), `page` from $app/state, `
directory_structure: src/lib/brackets (pure engine), src/lib/server/{db,auth,modules,services,testing} (server only; services/* are the shared business layer), src/lib/components (Svelte components; bracket/ for the canvas), src/lib/themes, src/lib/styles (_tokens.scss, global.scss), src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/ (public tournament pages + admin/ tabs), drizzle/ (SQL migrations + meta snapshots), e2e/ (Playwright), messages/en.json (Paraglide), docs/PLAN.md (roadmap + implementation notes).
